mapper.update: UPDATE content SET last_sync_yn = 'N' WHERE content_type = #{contentType} AND reg_type = 'API' AND last_sync_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO content ( title ,body ,content_type ,visible_yn ,ordering ,content_link ,created_at ,last_sync_yn ,reg_type ) VALUES
( IFNULL(#{item.safetyCateNm3}, '행동요령 참고 자료') ,#{item.body} ,#{contentType} ,'Y' ,#{item.ordering} ,#{item.contentsUrl} ,NOW() ,'Y' ,'API' )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM content WHERE reg_type = 'API' AND last_sync_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT code_item_id FROM code_item WHERE description = #{description} LIMIT 1

SELECT c.content_id ,c.title ,c.body ,c.content_type ,ci.code_item_name AS content_type_name ,cgi.code_group_name AS group_name ,REPLACE(c.content_link, 'http://mepv2.safekorea.go.kr', '') AS content_link ,c.ordering ,c.visible_yn ,c.last_sync_yn ,c.reg_type ,c.created_at ,c.last_update_date FROM content c LEFT JOIN code_item ci ON c.content_type = ci.code_item_id LEFT JOIN code_group cgi ON ci.code_group_id = cgi.code_group_id WHERE c.content_id = #{contentId}
